question: Is docs/FEEDBACK_LOOP_SPEC.md's fully automatic vision retired in favour of the optional, always-visible model, so the spec is rewritten as part of this work?
answer: Yes: the decided model is optional and acceptance-gated, so the spec's 'context.md evolves automatically, no manual editing' vision is retired and the spec is rewritten in the same work to describe carve-out proposals, acceptance and their history.
